title: The Exception
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens The Exception and the helm marks Research Shard. Do: Close on Research Shard. One sanctioned shard. The License Warden orbits it. The plague hook is the other body and is not a gift. Finish: come inside Research Shard's shell. The Choir writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
